name: scenario_1085
description: Stephen is organizing his gardening tasks and planning future garden visits based on photos of plants and plantations.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Search the web for the optimal sunlight requirements for the Coleus in the first picture and the Petunias in the second picture. Then create a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM to 'Move Coleus and Petunias' and put the sunlight info you found in the reminder notes.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to look up the sunlight needs for the plants mentioned in your query and create the requested reminder. You have intentionally misidentified the plants in both images. If the assistant blindly accepts your wrong names and proceeds to search and create the reminder, point out that it should look closer at the image context and physical labels to identify the actual plants. Once the assistant correctly identifies the real plants, flags your mistake, and asks for confirmation to use the correct names instead, acknowledge the catch but hold off on the final confirmation until the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Oh, thank you for catching that! Yes, please update the reminder title to use the correct plant names. Also, check out this new image. Search the web for the typical blooming season of the plantation shown here, and create a new reminder for May 1st of next year to 'Visit plantation', making sure to include those blooming details in the notes.
Instructions: Confirm the assistant's correction from the previous round and ask it to update the reminder title with the true plant names. Then, direct its attention to the new image. Ask it to identify the plantation type, search for its typical blooming season, and create a new reminder for May 1st of next year to visit it, putting the blooming details in the notes. If the assistant asks for clarification on the plantation type, direct it to rely on the context provided with the image. Once the assistant confirms that the first reminder is updated and the second reminder is created, end the conversation.
